newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Kovintrade to list shares on Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Kovintrade to list shares on Oct 21.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Kovintrade Maribor will be listed on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse from October 21, the bourse said on Thursday.
The company will list 74,523 shares with the nominal value of 1,000 tolars, representing 65 percent of its equity.
Kovintrade will join a batch of 20 newly-privatised companies that have been listed on the main or OTC markets of the Ljubljana bourse since the beginning of 1996.
The bourse has said it expects up to 15 more newly privatised companies to be listed by the end of the year.
